notes: First real content deploy of the audit series: 8 new articles went live (45 -> 53) and entered the sitemap immediately (67 -> 75 URLs); all 8 carry FAQPage, exactly one H1, full title/meta/canonical and return in 0.54-0.71s. Health still fell 84 -> 83 because Performance dropped 93 -> 87: the under-1s share went 89.7% -> 78.9% and /articles slowed 1.23s -> 2.16s under the larger unpaginated listing. Core-page TTFB of 0.81s matches 03 Aug exactly, so yesterday's 0.70s was the outlier rather than today being a regression. Crawlability slipped 89 -> 88 because the /articles listing still renders only 16 article links, now 16 of 53 instead of 16 of 45. Structured Data 80 -> 81 and Content 77 -> 79 on the new articles. JSON-LD duplication is unfixed for a third day and the 8 new articles inherit it (32 blocks / 4 payloads), confirming a shared component or layout is at fault. Project pages gained copy (161-178 -> 225-241 words) but still carry 0 schema and 16/20 images without alt on day five.

structured_data.jsonld_duplication_note: Day 3 unfixed. Core pages 14 blocks / 1 distinct payload, homepage 24 / 2, articles 31-32 / 4. Site-wide average factor ~10x; the true distinct schema count is roughly one tenth of the raw block count.
